title: Power Of Attorney By A Company To Its Branch Manager
description: A power of attorney by a company to its branch manager used for authorization documents granting legal authority to act on behalf of another. Suitable for principals granting power, or attorneys receiving authority to act. Key details required: Place (First Party), Age (in years) (First Party), Age (in years) (Second Party), Details, Age (in years) (Third Party).
description_hi: Power Of Attorney By A Company To Its Branch Manager — दूसरे की ओर से कार्य करने का कानूनी अधिकार देने वाले प्राधिकरण दस्तावेज के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला कानूनी प्रारूप। शक्ति प्रदान करने वाले प्रधान, या कार्य करने का अधिकार प्राप्त करने वाले अधिवक्ता के लिए उपयुक्त। 8 आवश्यक विवरण भरने होंगे।
